text: 江波龙公告称，公司此前审议通过回购股份方案，拟使用4.00亿元-8.00亿元自有或自筹资金，以集中竞价方式回购股份用于股权激励或员工持股计划，回购价格不超过735.00元/股，回购期限为董事会审议通过之日起12个月内。2026年9月8日，公司首次以集中竞价方式回购A股股份124.9455万股，占公司A股总股本的0.29%，最高成交价365.38元/股，最低成交价353.52元/股，成交总金额4.48亿元（不含交易费用）。公司后续将根据市场情况在回购期限内继续实施回购方案。
text_en: Longsys announced that its board previously approved a share buyback plan to repurchase shares via centralized bidding for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans, using 400 million to 800 million yuan of its own or self-raised funds, at a price not exceeding 735.00 yuan per share, within 12 months from board approval. On September 8, 2026, the company repurchased 1,249,455 A-shares for the first time via centralized bidding, accounting for 0.29% of total A-shares, with highest transaction price of 365.38 yuan/share and lowest of 353.52 yuan/share, totaling 448 million yuan (excluding transaction fees). The company will continue implementing the buyback plan based on market conditions within the buyback period.
